2126007592115741162.en_summary: More activists are piling up on Strata Critical Medical $SRTA, with Third Point disclosing a 5.8% stake and pushing for a strategic review (a sale). We flagged this one in April. The shares moved up quite a bit soon after but are now roughly flat since. Strata has a unique profile, specializing in air and ground organ transportation. Solid top-line growth driven by secular tailwinds (regulation, health, aging population), inflecting operating earnings, and a solid balance sheet. Coverage is picking up, with liquidity and visibility improving. Roughly 10x forward EV/EBITDA (on our guesstimated EBITDA), for 20-25% EBITDA growth pa over the medium-term.
2126007592115741162.zh_summary: 更多激進投資者正在 Strata Critical Medical $SRTA 上積累，Third Point 披露 5.8% 持股並推動戰略審查（出售）。我們在 4 月標註了這隻股票。股價隨後大幅上漲，但自那以後大致持平。Strata 具有獨特的概況，專門從事空中和地面器官運輸。受世俗順風（監管、健康、人口老齡化）推動的穩健營收增長、拐點經營盈利以及穩健的資產負債表。覆蓋正在增加，流動性和能見度正在改善。大約 10 倍遠期 EV/EBITDA（根據我們估計的 EBITDA），中期每年 20-25% 的 EBITDA 增長。

ticker_notes.SRTA: Third Point 5.8% stake pushing for sale; ~10x forward EV/EBITDA for 20-25% EBITDA growth, unique organ transport profile
